lines.text: Tap a state to visit it.
Pick any one you like. None of them is wrong.
Pick a picture at the bottom to see more.
Tap the camera to see a real photograph.
Tap the turtle and I will talk more slowly.
Take your time. I will wait right here.
Let us go back to India.
One moment. I am getting it ready for you.
One more place, then? Come on.
You have heard everything here. Well done!
Well done! You have a new stamp.
This is your passport. Look how far you have gone!
Every place you finish puts a stamp in here.
Bye for now. Come back and see me soon!
